actions.reason: Strong biological support: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of interferon/inflammatory pathways with large effect sizes, and WXS shows significant BAP1 enrichment (q=0.0044). Cross-modal consistency is moderate with median support count 3 and positive RNA/WSI silhouettes. Confounder exclusion shows a significant site enrichment (CJ) but this is a single technical factor and does not override the coherent biological signal. No better-supported structural action or resolvable evidence gap exists.

No significant biological enrichment across RNA, WXS, or CNV (all q near 1.0). Strong technical confounding by CT manufacturer/scanner/kernel (multiple FDR-significant associations) suggests the set is defined by technical factors rather than biology. Cross-modal consistency is driven almost entirely by CT (silhouette 0.276) with weak or negative support from other modalities. The set lacks a defensible biological identity and is better explained by technical variation.

No significant biological enrichment across any modality (all q high). Cross-modal consistency is weak with near-zero silhouettes in most modalities and low patient support. No significant technical confounders, but the absence of any biological signal or structural support means the set cannot be retained as a distinct entity. No resolvable evidence gap exists, and the evidence is insufficient for a supported non-terminal action.

Biological support is coherent: RNA shows extensive FDR-significant pathway enrichment (25/50) with large effect sizes, and CNV shows consistent significant losses on multiple arms. Cross-modal consistency is moderate with positive WSI/RNA silhouettes and high resampling ARI (0.561). No significant per-set technical confounders. The set has a defensible molecular identity with corroboration across RNA and CNV, and no better-supported structural action or resolvable gap exists.

Biological support is primarily transcriptional with strong FDR-significant RNA pathway enrichment (coagulation, EMT up; metabolic down) and large effect sizes. Cross-modal consistency shows RNA as the strongest driver with moderate patient support. No significant per-set technical confounders. While WXS/CNV are not significant, the RNA signal is robust and coherent, and the set is not better explained by technical factors or structural issues.
